DAMGHANI:v1p189/r8.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p189/r8.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p189/r8.anchor: الثاني : رابية يعني شديدة قوله تعالى في سورة الحاقة

NAHHAS:v5p19/r26.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p19/r26.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p19/r26.claim: The adjective رابية means increased or excessive.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p450/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p450/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p450/r7.claim: A messenger is the universe’s King’s envoy, so disobeying him is rebellion that merits a rebel’s punishment.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p450/r7.anchor: A messenger of God is an envoy of the King of the universe.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p450/r8.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p450/r8.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p450/r8.claim: Akhdhatan rābiyatan is an indefensible, unbearable seizure, unlike a temporary punishment meant to warn and remind.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p450/r8.anchor: One type of God’s punishment is that which is only meant to warn and remind people.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p256/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p256/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p256/r1.claim: Rasūl is collective and means each messenger sent by God; other views identify Lot because he is nearest in context or Moses because he appears earlier, and it may mean a message.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p256/r1.anchor: فعصوا رسول ربهم: رسول جنس، وهو من جاءهم من عند الله تعالى

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p256/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p256/r2.speaker: مجاهد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p256/r2.claim: Mujāhid says rابيَة means severe, exceeding other acts of seizure such as drowning or overturning the towns.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p256/r2.anchor: قال مجاهد: شديدة، يريد أنها زادت على غيرها من الأخذات

RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r1.claim: If the pronoun refers to Pharaoh and those before him, their messenger is Moses.
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r1.anchor: الضمير إن كان عائدا إلى { فرعون ومن قبله } ( الحاقة : 9 ) ، فرسول ربهم هو موسى عليه السلام

RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r2.claim: If it refers to the people of the overturned cities, their messenger is Lot.
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r2.anchor: وإن كان عائدا إلى أهل المؤتفكات فرسول ربهم هو لوط

RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r3.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r3.claim: Al-Wāḥidī says both Moses and Lot are intended: the verse reports the two peoples’ disobedience after naming them both.
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r3.anchor: قال الواحدي : والوجه أن يقال : المراد بالرسول كلاهما للخبر عن الأمتين

RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r4.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r4.claim: Al-Wāḥidī compares the collective singular messenger here with the wording in 26:16.
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r4.anchor: فيكون كقوله : { إنا رسول رب العالمين } ( الشعراء : 16 )

RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r5.claim: Rābiya derives from rabā, to increase or grow.
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r5.anchor: يقال : ربا الشيء يربو إذا زاد

RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r6.claim: One explanation is that their punishment exceeded that of other disbelievers because their deeds were exceptionally vile.
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r6.anchor: الأول : أنها كانت زائدة في الشدة على عقوبات سائر الكفار كما أن أفعالهم كانت زائدة في القبح

RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r7.claim: Another explanation is that Pharaoh’s worldly punishment continued into the afterlife, so the punishment seemed to grow; 71:25 says they were drowned and then brought into a fire.
RAZI-FULL:v30p93#4/r7.anchor: الثاني : أن عقوبة آل فرعون في الدنيا كانت متصلة بعذاب الآخرة ، لقوله : { أغرقوا فأدخلوا نارا } ( نوح : 25 )

STUDYQURAN:69:9/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r1.claim: The passage shifts from the destruction of pre-Islamic Arabian disbelievers to opponents of prophets in the Judeo-Christian tradition.
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r1.anchor: These verses mark a shift from the discussion of the afflictions that befell the disbelievers from pre-Islamic Arabian tribes to those who disbelieved in prophets of the Judeo-Christian tradition

STUDYQURAN:69:9/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r5.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r5.claim: The messenger of their Lord may be Moses, Lot, or both.
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r5.anchor: The messenger of their Lord could refer to Moses, Lot, or both (R)

STUDYQURAN:69:9/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r6.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r6.claim: Rusūl may mean “message” (risālah), allowing the verse to refer to any disbelieving peoples mentioned in the sūrah.
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r6.anchor: which case the verse may refer to any of the disbelieving peoples mentioned in this sūrah

STUDYQURAN:69:9/r7.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r7.speaker: Q, R
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r7.claim: Rābiyah indicates increase and can mean a punishment surpassing all others.
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r7.anchor: Devastating translates rābiyah, which indicates increase, suggesting either a punishment that surpasses that of all others (Q, R)

STUDYQURAN:69:9/r8.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r8.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r8.claim: It can mean punishment devastating in this world but even more severe in the Hereafter, as with Noah’s people, drowned and then made to enter the Fire.
STUDYQURAN:69:9/r8.anchor: more severe in the Hereafter, as with those who disbelieved in Noah: They were drowned, then made to enter a Fire (71:25; R)

TAB-FULL:v23p219/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p219/r1.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v23p219/r1.claim: Mujāhid glosses the seizure as severe.

TAB-FULL:v23p219/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p219/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v23p219/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās likewise glosses the seizure as severe.
TAB-FULL:v23p219/r2.anchor: عن أبيه، عن ابن عباس، قوله: {فأخذهم أخذة رابية} [الحاقة: 10] يعني أخذة شديدة

TAB-FULL:v23p219/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p219/r3.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v23p219/r3.claim: Ibn Zayd says increase can be in good or evil: God increased guidance for the guided and punishment for the disbelievers.
TAB-FULL:v23p219/r3.anchor: قال ابن زيد في قول الله: {فأخذهم أخذة رابية} [الحاقة: 10] قال: كما يكون في الخير رابية كذلك يكون في الشر رابية، قال: ربا عليهم: زاد عليهم

TABATABAI:69:6-12/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r12.speaker: author
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r12.claim: The subject of “they disobeyed” is Pharaoh, the peoples before him, and the overturned towns; “the messenger” means messengers collectively.

TABATABAI:69:6-12/r13.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r13.speaker: author
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r13.claim: Rābiya means increased or rising, from rabā, yarbū, rabwatan; the punishment was severe.
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r13.anchor: والرابية الزائدة من ربا يربو ربوة إذا زاد

TABATABAI:69:6-12/r14.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r14.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r14.claim: One alternative explains the punishment as exceeding other punishments.
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r14.anchor: وقيل العقوبة الزائدة على سائر العقوبات

TABATABAI:69:6-12/r15.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r15.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:69:6-12/r15.claim: Another alternative says the punishment was extraordinary and outside the ordinary course.

BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r10.claim: Each community disobeyed its own messenger; rasūl functions collectively because this noun form can be invariant for gender and number, and the generic possessive is distributive across the communities.
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r10.anchor: فعصى كل أمة رسولهم حين نهاهم عما كانوا يتعاطونه من القبائح

BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r11.claim: God seized each of those communities with punishment.
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r11.anchor: أي الله تعالى بالعقوبة أي كل قوم منهم

BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r12.claim: Their seizure exceeded the severity customary among people or the punishment of other unbelievers because their sins were more heinous; rābiya derives from the sense of increase.
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r12.anchor: أي زائدة في الشدة على عقوبات سائر الكفار أو على القدر المعروف عند الناس

BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r13.claim: Examples include drowning Noah's rejecters, overturning and stoning Lot's towns before burying them in foul water, and drowning Pharaoh's troops in the Red Sea or Nile; each people received fitting recompense.
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r13.anchor: أغرق من كذب نوحا وهم كل أهل الأرض غير من ركب معه في السفينة

BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r14.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r14.claim: These punishments warn Quraysh against denial and provide an awakening lesson for people of understanding.
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r14.anchor: وفي كل ذلك تخويف لقريش وتحذير لهم عن التكذيب وفيه عبرة موقظة لأولي الألباب

BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r15.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r15.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r15.claim: The root rabā means to grow or increase; legal ribā is the extra amount the creditor takes beyond what was lent.
BURSEVI:v10p102#2/r15.anchor: ربا الشيء يربو إذ زاد ومنه الربا الشرعي وهو الفضل الذي يأخذه

TABRISI:69:8-10/r14.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:69:8-10/r14.speaker: author
TABRISI:69:8-10/r14.claim: The nations disobeyed the messenger of their Lord in what he commanded.
TABRISI:69:8-10/r14.anchor: فيما أمرهم به وقيل: إن المراد بالرسول الرسالة

TABRISI:69:8-10/r15.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:69:8-10/r15.speaker: أبو مسلم
TABRISI:69:8-10/r15.claim: Abu Muslim says rasūl here means the message, as in the cited poem; the plain sense, the messenger himself, is stronger.

TABRISI:69:8-10/r16.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:69:8-10/r16.speaker: ابن عباس
TABRISI:69:8-10/r16.claim: Ibn Abbas explains the punishment as increased in severity; others say it exceeded the torment of other nations, or was high, notorious, and extraordinary.
TABRISI:69:8-10/r16.anchor: أي زائدة في الشدة عن ابن عباس

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r6.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r6.claim: Al-Kalbi identifies the messenger as Moses.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r6.anchor: قال الكلبي: يعني موسى بن عمران

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r7.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r7.claim: Muqatil identifies the messenger as Lot.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r8.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r8.claim: Al-Wahidi says the messenger should mean both Moses and Lot, since the verse speaks of the two peoples just mentioned; compare “We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds.”
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r8.anchor: والوجه أن يقال: المراد ب"الرسول" كلاهما للخبر عن

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r9.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r9.claim: The commentators gloss the punishment as growing, high, overwhelming, severe, or surpassing other peoples’ punishment.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r9.anchor: شديدة، زائدة على عذاب الأمم، كل هذا من ألفاظهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r10.speaker: المبرد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r10.claim: Al-Mubarrad says it means severe and great, deriving from increase.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r10.anchor: قال المبرد: أي شديدة، وكبيرة، وأصله من الزيادة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r11.speaker: الزجاج
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r11.claim: Al-Zajjaj says it increases beyond events.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r11.anchor: وقال الزجاج: معنى رأبية: تزيد على الأحداث

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r12.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r12.speaker: صاحب النظم
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r12.claim: The author of al-Naẓm calls it extreme in severity and explains rabā as increasing and multiplying.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p145/r12.anchor: وقال صاحب النظم: بالغة في الشدة، يقال: ربا الشيء يربو

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:7-11/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:7-11/r10.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:7-11/r10.claim: They disobeyed their Lord’s messenger and received an increased punishment exceeding other punishments.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:7-11/r10.anchor: { فعصوا رسول ربهم فأخذهم أخذة رابية } زائدة تزيد على الأخذات.

QASHANI:69:9-12/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:69:9-12/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:69:9-12/r3.claim: Their Lord’s messenger is the intellect that guides toward truth; their punishment drowns them in prime matter and disorders and ruins the body's temperament.
QASHANI:69:9-12/r3.anchor: أي: العقل الهادي إلى الحق { فأخذهم } بالغرق في بحر الهيولى

QASHANI:69:9-12/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:69:9-12/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:69:9-12/r4.claim: The seizure is an increase in severity.

ELMALILI:69:10-12/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:69:10-12/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:69:10-12/r1.claim: Rabiya is an increasing, overwhelming grip whose force rises in proportion to the degree of their disobedience.
ELMALILI:69:10-12/r1.anchor: Gittikçe artan, mütezâyid onların isyanlarının ziyadeliği nisbetinde şiddeti artan kāhir bir kabza.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:9/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:9/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:9/r4.claim: Each people disobeyed its own prophet and accused him of lying, so each faced a severe punishment; the singular “messenger” denotes a separate prophet for each community.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:9/r4.anchor: 10. âyetteki “resul” kelimesinin tekil olması her bir kavme gönderilmiş olan ayrı bir peygamberi ifade eder

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p484/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p484/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p484/r1.claim: The people were seized with a high or overwhelming punishment, one that is much spoken of.

MAJAZ:v2p267/r5.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v2p267/r5.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v2p267/r5.claim: Rābiya means increasing, growing, and severe, from rabāʾ, growth.
MAJAZ:v2p267/r5.anchor: «أخذة رابية» (10) نامية زائدة شديدة من الرباء..

ZAJJAJ:v5p214#2/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p214#2/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p214#2/r4.claim: Their disobedience included denying their messengers.
ZAJJAJ:v5p214#2/r4.anchor: قوله: (فعصوا رسول ربهم فأخذهم أخذة رابية (10) لإأنهم كذبوا رسلهم.

ZAJJAJ:v5p214#2/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p214#2/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p214#2/r5.claim: Rābiya describes a seizure or punishment that exceeds other afflictions.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r1.claim: Each nation disobeyed its own messenger when he forbade its reprehensible practices; the singular “messenger” may be understood literally.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r1.anchor: أي فعصى كل أمة رسولها حين نهاها عما كانت تتعاطاه من القبائح فإفراد الرسول على ظاهره

ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r2.claim: Alternatively, “messenger” can denote a plural: it was originally a verbal noun, and context requires multiplicity; the construction distributes the plural or unifies the messengers because their message was the same.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r2.anchor: وجوز أن يكون جمعا أو مما يستوي فيه الواحد وغيره لأنه مصدر في الأصل وأريد منه التكثير لأقتضاء السياق له

ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r3.claim: Their disobedience explains their coming with the sinful deed just mentioned.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r3.anchor: والظاهر أن هذا بيان لمجيئهم بالخاطئة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r4.claim: The one who seized them is God.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r5.claim: A rabiya seizure is an increase in severity, just as their reprehensible deeds increased in ugliness; the word derives from increase.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p42#4/r5.anchor: ﴿ أخذة رابية ﴾ أي زائدة في الشدة كما زادت قبائحهم في القبح من ربا الشيء إذا زاد

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r21.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r21.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r21.claim: The messengers meant collectively here are Lot and Moses.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r22.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r22.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r22.anchor: {فأخذهم أخذة رابية} نامية. قال ابن عباس رضي الله تعالى عنهما: شديدة.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r23.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r23.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r23.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses the punishment as severe.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r23.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله تعالى عنهما: شديدة.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r24.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r24.speaker: قيل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p208/r24.claim: Another explanation says their punishment exceeded the punishments of earlier nations.

BAYDAWI-FULL:69:8-10/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:8-10/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:8-10/r6.claim: Each community disobeyed its own messenger.

BAYDAWI-FULL:69:8-10/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:8-10/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:8-10/r7.claim: The seizure exceeded ordinary severity in proportion to the increased ugliness of their deeds.
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:8-10/r7.anchor: زائدة في الشدة زيادة أعمالهم في القبح

BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r1.claim: The singular “messenger” can stand for the messengers collectively because they share the purpose of calling people to God and obedience.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r1.anchor: ولما كان الرسل كلهم جميعا كالفرد الواحد لاتفاق مقاصدهم في الدعاء إلى الله والحمل على طاعته

BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r2.claim: Each community opposed the messenger sent by its beneficent Lord, who created them, gave them faculties and provision, and sent guidance; they wrongly assumed their benefactor could not harm them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r2.anchor: خالفت كل أمة من أرسله المحسن إليها بإبداعها من العدم وإيداعها القوى وترزيقها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r3.claim: God’s seizure completely eliminated every people who denied its messenger, unlike a human pursuer who cannot catch every enemy; this reflects His comprehensive knowledge and power.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r3.anchor: لم يبق من أمة منهم أحدا ممن كذب الرسول فلم يكن كمن ينصر على عدو من الأدميين

BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r4.claim: “Rābiya” describes a mighty, elevated seizure that exceeds bounds and grows in proportion to the wickedness of their deeds; growth is the root sense of ribā.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r5.claim: The punishment included Pharaoh and his army, Noah’s deniers across the earth except those aboard the ark, and Lot’s towns, which were uprooted, overturned, stoned, and flooded.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p124/r5.anchor: فأغرق فرعون وجنوده , وأغرق كل من كذب نوحا عليه السلام , وهم كل أهل الأرض غير من ركب معه في السفينة

DURR-FULL:v8p265/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p265/r12.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p265/r12.claim: Mujāhid explains the “rising” seizure as severe.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r4.claim: The clause detailing their sin elaborates the preceding statement, like the elaboration about Noah’s people in 54:9.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r4.anchor: وفرع عنه تفصيل ذنبهم المعبر عنه بالخاطئة فقال { فعصوا رسول ربهم } وهذا التفريع للتفصيل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r5.claim: The pronoun may return to Pharaoh as head of his people, with them included; the contextual clue is clear in the majority reading.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r5.anchor: وضمير ( عصوا ) يجوز أن يرجع إلى { فرعون } باعتباره رأس قومه ، فالضمير عائد إليه وإلى قومه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r6.speaker: أبو عمرو والكسائي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r6.claim: Ibn ʿĀshūr says the contextual identification is clearer in the readings of Abū ʿAmr and al-Kisāʾī.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r6.anchor: وإما على قراءة أبي عمرو والكسائي فالأمر أظهر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r7.claim: On the reading that the pronoun refers to Pharaoh and his people, their Lord’s Messenger is Moses.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r7.anchor: يكون المراد ب { رسول ربهم } موسى عليه السلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r8.claim: Alternatively, the pronoun refers to Pharaoh, earlier peoples, and the overturned cities; their Messenger is the messenger sent to each group.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r8.anchor: هو الرسول المرسل إلى كل قوم من هؤلاء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r9.claim: The singular “Messenger” is distributed across the communities and is more elegant than “messengers,” avoiding three consecutive plurals.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r9.anchor: فإفراد { رسول } مراد به التوزيع على الجماعات ، أي رسول الله لكل جماعة منهم ، والقرينة ظاهرة ، وهو أجمل نظما

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r10.claim: The possessive “their Lord” hints at their error of worshipping Pharaoh and treating him as their god.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r10.anchor: لما في لفظ المضاف إليه من الإشارة إلى تخطئتهم في عبادة فرعون وجعلهم إياه إلاها لهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r11.claim: Taking is used here for destruction, a usage discussed elsewhere in the Quran.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p121/r11.anchor: والأخذ : مستعمل في الإهلاك ، وقد تقدم عند قوله تعالى : أخذناهم بغتة فإذا هم مبلسون في سورة الأنعام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r1.claim: An akhdha is a single taking, here Pharaoh and his people’s drowning; if the antecedent includes other peoples, it distributes one taking to each nation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r1.anchor: وأخذة : } واحدة من الأخذ ، فيراد بها أخذ فرعون وقومه بالغرق ، كما قال تعالى : { فأخذناهم أخذ عزيز مقتدر }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r2.claim: Rābiya is the active participle of rabā-yarbū, “increase”; its wāw becomes yāʾ because it is mobile after a kasra.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r2.anchor: اسم فاعل من ربا يربو إذا زاد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r3.claim: The image of increase is borrowed for severity; the taking is total destruction leaving none alive.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p122/r3.anchor: واستعير الربو هنا للشدة كما تستعار الكثرة للشدة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r10.claim: The messenger may be a collective noun for the prophets sent to each people, or may mean the message itself.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r10.anchor: يحتمل أن يكون الرسول: اسم جنس كأنه قال: فعصا هؤلاء الأقوام والفرق أنبياء الله الذين أرسلهم إليهم، ويحتمل أن يكون الرسول بمعنى: الرسالة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r11.speaker: الكلبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r11.claim: Al-Kalbi identifies the messenger as Moses.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r12.speaker: غيره في كتاب الثعلبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r12.claim: Another report in al-Thaʿlabi’s book identifies the messenger as Lot.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r12.anchor: وقال غيره في كتاب الثعلبي: يعني لوطا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r13.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r13.claim: Rabiya means greatly increased or grown, related to growth in wealth, usury, and the phrase اهتزت وربت.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p357#2/r13.anchor: والرابية: النامية التي قد عظمت جدا، ومنه ربا المال، ومنه الربا، ومنه اهتزت وربت

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p348/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p348/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p348/r1.claim: Their disobedience to their Lord's messenger means that they denied their messengers.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p348/r1.anchor: فعصوا رسول ربهم أي كذبوا رسلهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p348/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p348/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p348/r2.claim: The punishment was excessive, exceeding the ordinary occurrences or events.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p348/r2.anchor: فأخذهم أخذة رابية أي زائدة على الأحداث

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r8.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r8.claim: The singular messenger is generic: each people denied the messenger sent to them, and whoever rejects one messenger rejects them all.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r8.anchor: وهذا جنس، أي: كل كذب رسول الله إليهم. كما قال: {كل كذب الرسل فحق وعيد}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r9.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r9.claim: God's seizure was great, severe, and painful.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r9.anchor: فأخذهم أخذة رابية} أي: عظيمة شديدة أليمة.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r10.speaker: مجاهد والسدي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r10.claim: Mujahid calls the seizure severe, while al-Suddi calls it destructive.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p209/r10.anchor: قال مجاهد: {رابية} شديدة. وقال السدي: مهلكة.

JISHUMI:v10p7056/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7056/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7056/r1.claim: Rābiya can mean greater than the nations' punishment or extraordinarily overwhelming; it means a blow surpassing every other, not punishment beyond what was deserved.
JISHUMI:v10p7056/r1.anchor: أخذا فوق كل أخذ، ولم يرد الزيادة على المستحق.

JISHUMI:v10p7056/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7056/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7056/r7.claim: The seizure proves punishment is deserved for people's deeds, against the Mujabbiṣa.
JISHUMI:v10p7056/r7.anchor: ومنها: قوله: فأخذهم أن العقوبة تستحق على أفعالهم، خلاف قول المجبرة.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p604/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p604/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p604/r5.claim: رابية means intense and excessive; the punishment exceeded in severity as their abominations exceeded in vileness; the root denotes increase as in 30:39.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p604/r5.anchor: شديدة زائدة في الشدة ، كما زادت قبائحهم في القبح . يقال : ربا الشيء يربو

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p77/r16.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p77/r16.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p77/r16.claim: One sense is that they disobeyed God's messenger by denying him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p77/r16.anchor: أحدهما : فعصوا رسول الله إليهم بالتكذيب .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p77/r17.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p77/r17.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p77/r17.claim: Alternatively, they disobeyed God's message; messenger can stand for the message, as a poetic citation is introduced to show.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p77/r17.anchor: الثاني : فعصوا رسالة الله إليهم بالمخالفة , وقد يعبر عن الرسالة بالرسول , قال الشاعر :

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r1.claim: The poem's use of rasul illustrates the metonymy by which a message is called a messenger.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r1.anchor: لقد كذب الواشون ما بحت عندهم … بسر ولا أرسلتهم برسول .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r4.speaker: أبو عمران الجوني
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r4.claim: Abu Imran al-Jawni describes it as their being kept in God's punishment forever.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r4.anchor: الثالث : تربوبهم في عذاب الله أبدا , قاله أبو عمران الجوني .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r5.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r5.claim: The punishment was elevated or surpassing.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r6.speaker: ابن زيد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r6.claim: Ibn Zayd calls it an increase or excess in evil.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p79/r6.anchor: الخامس : رابية للشر , قاله ابن زيد .

MUQATIL:69:5-12/r13.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:69:5-12/r13.speaker: author
MUQATIL:69:5-12/r13.claim: The messenger whom the people of Lot disobeyed was Lot.
MUQATIL:69:5-12/r13.anchor: يعني لوطا { فأخذهم } الله { أخذة رابية }

MUQATIL:69:5-12/r14.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:69:5-12/r14.speaker: author
MUQATIL:69:5-12/r14.claim: God's seizure was severe, surpassing their own sins in severity.
MUQATIL:69:5-12/r14.anchor: يعني شديدة ربت عليهم في الشدة أشد من معاصيهم التي عملوها

NASAFI-FULL:v4p274#6/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p274#6/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p274#6/r1.claim: Those who disobeyed their Lord's messenger were Lot's people, and the messenger was Lot.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p274#6/r1.anchor: أي قوم لوط ﴿ رسول ربهم ﴾ لوط

NASAFI-FULL:v4p274#6/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p274#6/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p274#6/r2.claim: They were seized with exceptionally severe punishment, matching the increased ugliness of their offenses.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p274#6/r2.anchor: شديدة زائدة في الشدة كما زادت قبائحهم في القبح

QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r1.speaker: الكلبي
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r1.claim: Al-Kalbi identifies the messenger they disobeyed as Moses.

QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r2.claim: Another view identifies the messenger as Lot, because he is closer in the passage.

QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r3.claim: A third view means both Moses and Lot, as in the address 'We are messengers of the Lord of the worlds' in 26:16.
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r3.anchor: وقيل: عنى موسى ولوطا عليهما السلام كما قال تعالى: فقولا إنا رسول رب العالمين

QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r4.claim: Another explanation takes rasūl to mean a message; the cited poet uses rasūl for a message sent to someone.
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r4.anchor: وقيل: «رسول» بمعنى رسالة. وقد يعبر عن الرسالة بالرسول قال الشاعر: لقد كذب الواشون ما بحت عندهم

QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r5.claim: Rābiya means high, increased, and multiplied: their seizure exceeded other peoples' punishments, as usury adds to the original amount; rabā means increase.
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r5.anchor: أي عالية زائدة على الأخذات وعلى عذاب الأمم. ومنه الربا إذا أخذ في الذهب والفضة أكثر مما أعطى. يقال: ربا الشيء يربو أي زاد وتضاعف.

QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r6.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r6.claim: Mujahid interprets rābiya as severe, meaning increased severity.
QURTUBI-FULL:69:10/r6.anchor: وقال مجاهد: شديدة. كأنه أراد زائدة في الشدة.
